changes.hypothesis: Explicit source roles and state/delivery contracts reduce ambiguity and false completion.
rejected_alternatives: One large portrait-plus-camera skill would load irrelevant live-control instructions for ordinary edits.
A generic new media-migration skill would overlap existing location/routing skills and obscure deletion authority.
regression_risks: Over-triggering on social copy or video.
Turning historical host details into fixed prerequisites.
Confusing static checks with measured real-world effectiveness.
changes.results: Analytical review approved with limits after fixture gate repair; portable/catalog structural checks passed. No live task result.
changes.limits: Fresh protected holdout and matched host runs remain required for stronger claims.

changes.hypothesis: Explicit all-required expectations prevent a heuristic flag from weakening the authority/privacy gate.
changes.change: Replace critical booleans with required:true on every anchored expectation and an explicit non-compensatory grading rubric.
rejected_alternatives: Leave inconsistent flags and rely on a distant release rubric.
changes.regression_risk: No operative instruction changes; fixture grading semantics become explicit.
changes.results: All three separate reviewer contexts verified the fixture-only correction and current hashes; approved with analytical limits.

changes.hypothesis: Explicit draftable metadata prevents heading-count heuristics from misclassifying an otherwise complete contract.

changes.results: Disruptor and negotiator verified exact one-line metadata diff and current hashes; no operative regression. Both catalog entries draftable/analytical/needs-live-evidence.
